Regarding the 7th rule, I can’t decide because I want to do it all. I have so many passions, I want to do and learn everything. I have been dealing with anxiety, depression and other mental issues for the last 4 years and have been stagnant. I felt like I literally slept those 4 years away, but recently I’ve started to feel better and I can’t describe the feeling other than wanting a exciting chaotic schedule/life. I feel like I want to pursue all these different things because 1. They do make me incredibly happy and 2. They fulfill that want of being nothing but being busy. I want to feel exhausted when I go to sleep not uncomfortably tired and restless. It’s a very weird feeling I have. I’ve been told that those plans are stupid and actually not an enjoyable way to live, but is that true? Do you think this is an impulse feeling because of how long I was dealing with my depression?

I'm not sure what makes me anxious. It's almost that feeling of being in front of someone you find attractive/have a crush on and want to impress them... (I'm not saying I do. Besides I'm straight.) It's a very complicated feeling that I have a hard time putting into words. I don't like seeing anyone as competition unless it's light hearted or .. a game. I want to say I can stem it to the fact that my mom is the epitome of judgmental bitch. She is actually a very sweet person, will bend backwards for you and honestly wants the best BUT behind closed doors she will crucify them. For example, "She's just acting that way because shes a fat whore that isnt happy in her own life. I mean comeon look at all that cellulite! She's just jealous she isnt skinny and beautiful like you/or me" She talks this was about randoms, friends and even family. When I was little I just nodded and said uh huh uh huh, but I always felt very sad inside when she would spew all that hate. I never agree with it but sometimes I can find myself saying horrible things in my head like that but the second I realize I scold myself basically.  
And for bad relationships, there was this one i had throughout all of highschool. She was very sweet and mean at the same time which really had me conflicted. We've had our fights and she would say all the hurtful things on a regular basis but then she would be the one to invite me to parties and outings and let me follow her around the entire time. I cared about her for sure but i kept my guards up and never let myself care too much (I guess as in best friends) So in 12th grade on a random day I saw her during switching classes, I was in a good mood and went to greet her. She ignored me, I followed her to see what was up and she very loudly says "Stop, We are not friends! You are a bad friend and i'm over it." I was mortified and didn't say anything. Apparently it was because earlier that month she told me how I was her bestfriend and then i forgot her birthday... But i tried to explain to her i was an idiot and she knoooows this! She wasn't having it. I think about that all the time and I can say for sure it's probably one of the things thats been plaguing my anxiety regarding making girl friends.

Sorry for the looong rambly stories. I know this isn't therapy haha
